exposure: Absence of surgery of bowel endometriosis (no-SBE)
outcome: Long-term symptoms of bowel endometriosis nodules (BEN)
cohort: The study included 76 women with deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE) from Arash Women's Hospital in Tehran, Iran.
finding: No statistically significant differences were found between women who underwent surgery for bowel endometriosis and those who did not, regarding long-term symptoms and recurrence of bowel endometriosis nodules.
